## Findings

1. **F1 — `--log` is documented as effective in foreground mode.** [docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2818](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2818) unconditionally says the flag writes server output to the selected file. The `Commands::Serve` foreground branch never reads `log_file` and leaves the child attached to the terminal; only daemon mode passes the log path into `ServeOptions`. Remediation: state that `--log` controls daemon output and is ignored with `--fg`, or document foreground behavior separately.

2. **F2 — The `error` status description omits daemon-start failures.** [docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2849](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2849) limits `error` to failed `--stop` and `--status` operations. The ordinary daemon-start branch also emits `{"status":"error","error":...}` when `start_server` fails. Remediation: describe `error` as covering start, stop, and status failures, with the accompanying `error` field.

Total findings: 2
